recipe.name: duckling_crest_puff_mk2c
recipe.rationale: Round-2 plan after round-1 rejections: the enlarged silhouette was geometrically valid (all lowest-Z inside the 3 mm base) but hit a STEP-vs-CAD volume mismatch of ~0.8-0.9%, likely a boolean/tolerance artifact aggravated by many overlapping ellipsoids with compound rotations. Fix: reduce to two puffs with simple single-axis rotations to lower boolean complexity while keeping the enlarged, recognizable friendly crest. Base stays 18x16x3; center puff 15x12x10 at [0,0,6.8] tilted only -10 deg about X (rotated Z half-extent ~5.37, lowest Z ~+1.43 mm, inside base with full XY overlap); single bilateral side puff (Y=+4 only, host mirrors) 10x6x7 at [-2.5,4,6] with one -15 deg X tilt (lowest Z ~+2.83 mm, overlapping base and center puff). No feature below Z=0; total ~18x16x~13 mm well inside 80x80x35 mm; mass far under 16 g. Whole-robot and close-up renders confirm the round-0/1 crest position is clear of the front camera lens and dome and merely needs presence, which this scale restores. Soft rounded ellipsoids only, no sharp intimidating edges. Adhesive-pad attachment, curvature fit, printability and walking remain open per the brief.
